proposals.name: Aviation Maintenance Technicians (AMTs) & Aircraft Mechanics
proposals.buyer_persona: Certified mechanics, avionics techs, and aerospace students who take extreme pride in their high-consequence, precise manual labor. They love dark safety-wire humor, FAA regulation memes (e.g., Part 43), and the 'safety-first but sarcastic' vibe.
product_angles: Humorous stickers for toolboxes (e.g., 'If it's not safety-wired, it's not mine', 'In FOD we trust... not')
KDP Logbooks specifically designed for tracking personal tool inventories or engine maintenance hours
Technical blueprint-style vector art of vintage aircraft engines for workshop posters
proposals.first_test_product: A set of 12 high-resolution toolbox sticker designs featuring insider aviation mechanic jokes and retro-industrial typography.

proposals.name: Ham Radio (Amateur Radio) & DXing Operators
proposals.buyer_persona: Mainly older tech enthusiasts, engineers, and survivalists who operate amateur radio stations. They obsess over signal propagation, call signs, specialized abbreviations (Q-codes), and exchanging custom physical postcards (QSL cards) worldwide.
product_angles: KDP Amateur Radio Logbooks with highly optimized tables for tracking UTC time, frequency, RST, and Call signs
Printable QSL Card templates that operators can purchase as digital downloads and print locally
Redbubble apparel featuring retro radio wave diagrams, vintage vacuum tubes, and '73' (best regards) typography
proposals.first_test_product: A highly functional, vintage-designed Ham Radio Operator Logbook with custom-designed interior templates for tracking contacts.

proposals.name: Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA) & Historical Fencing
proposals.buyer_persona: Athletes and history nerds who study medieval fighting manuals (Liechtenauer, Fiore dei Liberi). They invest heavily in protective gear, steel swords, and pride themselves on treating swordplay as a legitimate historical sport rather than live-action roleplay (LARP).
product_angles: KDP HEMA training journals featuring sparring logs, technique breakdown grids, and tournament tracking
Redbubble apparel with minimalist vector illustrations of guard positions (e.g., Vom Tag, Pflug) taken from authentic 15th-century treatises
3D printable accessories on Cults3D, such as custom sword wall mounts or protective gear drying hooks
proposals.first_test_product: A modular, 3D-printable wall mount for feder swords (HEMA training swords) that can be adjusted for different crossguard widths.

proposals.name: French Sapeurs-Pompiers (Local Firefighter Amicales)
proposals.buyer_persona: Members of local French volunteer and professional firefighter associations ('Amicales des Sapeurs-Pompiers'). They organize annual calendar distributions, local lotto nights, and community events, constantly needing custom regional merchandise and graphics.
product_angles: Vector design packs (SVG/PNG) featuring stylized French firefighting equipment, local department crests, and mascot designs for t-shirt printing
Customizable Canva templates for their annual 'Calendrier des Pompiers' layout sold as digital assets
Low-poly or stylized 3D printable firefighter helmet miniature keychains to sell during local charity drives
proposals.first_test_product: A vector pack of 15 premium, French-specific firefighting emblems, mascots, and vintage vehicle silhouettes for local customization.

proposals.name: Microbiology & Lab Tech Professionals
proposals.buyer_persona: Medical laboratory scientists, microbiologists, and pathology assistants who spend their days looking at petri dishes, staining bacteria, and running autoclaves. They love dark biological humor, antibiotic resistance jokes, and vibrant, colorful bacterial art.
product_angles: Aesthetic watercolor-style designs of pathologically accurate bacteria (e.g., Pseudomonas aeruginosa under UV, Gram-positive cocci) for print-on-demand mugs and tote bags
Stickers featuring lab-specific dark humor ('Living that agar life', 'Don't lick the plate')
KDP Lab Notebook covers with stylized, vintage scientific illustration aesthetics
proposals.first_test_product: A collection of 10 high-resolution transparent PNG stickers combining watercolor petri dish aesthetics with witty microbiology puns.

proposals.name: Home Hydroponics & Micro-farming Hobbyists
proposals.buyer_persona: Urban dwellers, tech-savvy growers, and sustainability advocates who set up DIY automated hydroponic, aquaponic, or aeroponic indoor systems. They obsess over pH levels, nutrient ratios, PPM tracking, and custom 3D printed system parts.
product_angles: Parametric 3D printable net pots, cloning collars, and modular water distribution manifolds for DIY Kratky or DWC systems on Cults3D
KDP Hydroponic Grow Journals featuring detailed layout grids for tracking pH, EC/PPM, water temperature, and nutrient schedules
Minimalist SVG icon packs for smart-home dashboard integrations monitoring indoor crop systems
proposals.first_test_product: A set of highly optimized, print-in-place modular hydroponic net cups designed to save plastic while maximizing root aeration, hosted on Cults3D.
